posts.trend: India postpones UPI payment fee rollout until after Diwali festival
posts.context: Financial regulatory grace periods aligned with major spending seasons.
posts.angle: The fee delay is not generosity; it is timing the fee after you exhaust your savings.
slides: The tax on your UPI transactions is postponed until after Diwali.

Buy sweet boxes — free transfer.
Send festival bonus to maid — free transfer.
Pay gold advance — free transfer.
Nov 1 account balance — ₹432.
They gave you permission to empty your account first.
posts.caption: Every Indian family has one person currently tracking their UPI limit on Google Pay.
posts.rank_verdict: The landing explains the joke instead of introducing a fresh, unexpected image.
